description:
Scan multiple medical bills in one call. Returns per-bill anomaly lists + total recovery estimate across the batch. Input is a list of {bill_text, provider?, insurer?} items (max 10 per call). Much faster than serial scan_bill_for_errors when handling a bulk upload.

WHEN TO USE: User has multiple bills or EOBs to review at once (e.g. a family's bills from one visit, or a year of statements).

WHEN NOT: For a single bill (use scan_bill_for_errors).
name: batch_scan_bills
